title: English Practice Quiz 0311
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: She is good at ___.
questions.explanation: A preposition such as at is followed by a noun or gerund.

questions.question: The keys are ___ the table.
questions.explanation: On describes something resting on a surface.

questions.question: Water ___ at 100°C at sea level.
questions.explanation: Use the present simple for general facts.

questions.question: A person you can trust is ___.
He wants to become ___ engineer.
questions.explanation: Engineer begins with a vowel sound, so use an.

questions.question: When I was five, I ___ swim.
You did not hear someone. You say:
questions.explanation: Could you repeat that, please? is a polite request.

questions.question: Read: 'Mina takes the bus at 8 a.m. and reaches work at 8:45.' How does Mina travel?
questions.explanation: The passage clearly says Mina takes the bus.

questions.question: To confirm an instruction, you can say:
options: Could you please confirm the details?
questions.explanation: Could you please confirm... is polite and precise.

questions.question: Which is a complete sentence?
questions.explanation: The team finished the work contains a subject and a complete predicate.
